name: print-social-navy-creative-marketing-agency-post-with-circle-photo-and-orbit-line
title: Navy 'Creative Marketing Agency' post with a large navy circle, circle photo and orbit line
whatItIs: A square white post with a large navy circle holding 'Creative' in thin white, 'MARKETING' in bold yellow and 'AGENCY' in white, a contact strip inside the circle, a circle-cropped photo of a smiling man in a light suit at a desk, thin navy orbit lines with dot ends and triangle outlines.
whatItMeans: Clean and professional; interlocking circles tie message and person together.
techniques: Overlap a text circle with a photo circle.
Trace an orbit line with dot ends around both.
Use weight contrast across three headline words.

vocabulary.definition: Two circles overlapping to link content.
A curved stroke circling a shape.
